days.title: Historical Center and Natural Landscapes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: abbazia di Monteveglio
stops.detail: The park coincides with the site of community interest Monteveglio Abbey (IT40500016).

stops.name: calanchi
stops.detail: Worthy of note are the badlands, which host a particular flora: some herbs are present such as the goldilocks aster (Aster linosyris) and to a lesser extent the wild carrot, the clay scorzonera (Podospermum canum);

stops.name: vigneti e coltivi
stops.detail: The park area, strongly anthropized and characterized by vineyards and cultivated land, alternates with an area covered by woods, prairies, and uncultivated land.

days.title: Woods and Waterways
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: zone boschive
stops.detail: Numerous small mammals are present in the Park: the European hedgehog is found almost everywhere, while the red squirrel, the hazel dormouse, the dormouse and the bank vole live only in the wooded areas;

stops.name: sponde dei torrenti
stops.detail: the European hare and the common vole frequent the meadows and fields and the European water vole, an excellent swimmer, makes its den on the banks of the torrents.

stops.name: ristagni tra i calanchi
stops.detail: in the stagnant waters among the badlands one finds coltsfoot (Tussilago farfara), woody fleabane (Dittrichia viscosa), and yellow-wort (Blackstonia perfoliata);

stops.name: fiumi
stops.detail: Among the birds of prey, the Kestrel and the Common Buzzard should be mentioned, while along the rivers live Grey Herons and Night Herons.
